levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن أبي عتيق

notes: the editor gloss «واسمه محمد بن إسماعيل بن يوسف» is left out; the name is the surface as the text gives it
«أصح من حديث أبي صفوان عن يونس» names another chain for the saying: a variant group
the Prophet ends the chain at Aisha; the later remarks on Abu Safwan and on the scholars' opinions are not chains
